data.name: DreadHold
data.detailed_description:
DreadHold is a relentless top-down roguelite horde shooter where survival is everything. Trapped in a shadowy building under siege by endless waves of enemies, your goal is simple: hold out as long as you can, barricading entrances and fighting back with whatever you've got.

Dive into fast-paced runs where every session feels fresh thanks to semi-procedural level generation - doorways might be blocked off or wide open, keeping you on your toes while the core layout stays familiar. Rack up points by mowing down foes, then spend them on upgrades mid-run to turn the tide: unlock lifesteal for staying in the fight, explosive bullets that detonate on critical hits, and more. These stack up as you go, letting you build insane loadouts to push further.

Between runs, invest in meta upgrades to beef up your starting stats, giving you that edge for the next attempt. Power-ups drop during the chaos too - grab double points, infinite ammo, or instant reloads to amp up the action. It's all single-player, set in perpetual night time for that tense, arcade vibe, drawing inspiration from classics like COD Zombies but with a top-down twist that makes every corner a potential kill zone.

Key features:

  • Intense horde defense with barricades and special events to shake things up.

  • Roguelite progression: in-run upgrades and meta unlocks for endless replayability.

  • Semi-procedural levels that mix familiarity with surprises.

  • Power-up drops to fuel epic moments in the heat of battle.

Whether you're grinding for high scores or just unleashing mayhem, DreadHold delivers non-stop adrenaline in a compact, addictive package.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD 2.5 GHz or superior
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any DirectX 11 or 12 compatible card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
